summary: GPGI, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on August 6, 2026, reporting its second quarter 2026 financial results and declaring a quarterly cash dividend of $0.0025 per share on Class A common stock, payable September 1, 2026, to holders of record as of August 17, 2026. The filing includes a press release and investor presentation furnished as exhibits. The company reiterates full-year 2026 guidance with pro forma adjusted net sales of $1.95–2.1 billion and adjusted EBITDA of $550–610 million. No special-situation transaction (merger, tender, strategic review, or similar) is disclosed; the dividend and results are routine operational disclosures. What to watch: continued execution against guidance and leverage targets.
